title: 20 Dog Teams Ran 674 Miles in 127 Hours at 50 Below Zero

scenes.text: Twenty dog teams ran 674 miles in blizzards at fifty below zero.
In 1925, an Alaskan town had diphtheria and no medicine.
The serum was 674 miles away. The trip normally took a month.
Twenty mushers passed the serum along like a baton. Most teams carried it about thirty miles.
Gale-force winds and blizzards hit them the whole way, with temperatures as low as minus sixty.
They did it in 127 hours, about five and a half days, and the medicine arrived.

description:
In 1925, twenty dog sled teams relayed medicine 674 miles to Nome, Alaska, in about 127 hours.
Temperatures dropped as low as minus 60 degrees Fahrenheit, and a trip that normally took a month took about five and a half days.
Which dog would you have picked for the final leg?
first_comment: Togo ran the longest and hardest leg, but Balto got the statue. Who deserves the credit?
